# BrioHR | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning | Modularized HRMS in South-East Asia, covering core administration, remuneration, recruitment, performance and attendance. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Boundaries to Competition | Open remuneration is clear only for Malaysia and Singapore; Hong Kong payroll tax is not presumed; minimum monthly fees and high fees based on actual numbers need to be included in TCO. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Public remuneration is clear only for Malaysia and Singapore; the Hong Kong payroll tax is non-presumptionable; minimum monthly fees and high fees based on actual numbers are to be included in TCO. |
